description: This file defines a class WPTGitHub for interacting with GitHub API, including creating pull requests, adding labels, merging PRs, and deleting branches.

classes.name: WPTGitHub
classes.description: A class for managing GitHub interactions such as creating pull requests, adding labels, merging, and deleting branches.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WPTGitHub object with host, user, and token.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the GitHub API with specified path, method, and optional body.

methods.name: create_pr
methods.description: Creates a pull request on GitHub with given branch, title, and body.

methods.name: add_label
methods.description: Adds a label to a specified issue or PR number.

methods.name: in_flight_pull_requests
methods.description: Retrieves open pull requests with a specific label.

methods.name: merge_pull_request
methods.description: Merges a pull request by number using rebase method.

methods.name: delete_remote_branch
methods.description: Deletes a remote branch on GitHub.
